critical_code_review_comments: ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — centerDecisions filter is correctly a 3-predicate chain (recommendation_type in {switch_vendor,renegotiate} AND decision_confidence>=0.80 AND observation_count>=3) capped at 7. Verified live: 2 cards rendered, both meet the gate.

ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — Dismiss uses session-local Set state; NO api.patch call in handleDismiss; reload correctly restores. Confirmed via live test (card count 2→1 after dismiss, 2 after reload).

ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — Accept routes through existing PurchaseSuggestionModal (reused, not duplicated). onClose refreshes /procurement/suggestions so the +1 saved count appears automatically.
ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — reviewDecisions excludes items already in centerDecisions (prevents double-counting). Good dedup guard.

ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — NotPursuedModal PATCH URL is /procurement/suggestions/{id}/outcome with outcome_type=not_pursued + outcome_note — matches existing backend contract, no backend change required.
OrdersPage.js — preseedItemIds prop seeds lines with quantity_ordered: 0 (empty), no vendor, and fires price-history fetch only as background enrichment inside try/catch — spec-compliant.
App.js — 8 legacy routes consolidated to <Navigate to='/procurement' replace/>; 4 /procurement/legacy/* deep-link escape hatches preserved separately so bookmarks don't break.
Layout.js — Procurement collapsed from NavGroup to single nav link (line 39). Clean removal of the old group children. nav-group-procurement testid correctly absent.
ProcurementCommandCenterPage.js — MiniSpark SVG sparklines render inline from p.trend.series without extra API calls (reuses existing price-intelligence payload). Good perf choice.
No backend file changed this iteration — git diff on /app/backend/ clean. Strict 'UI-only' constraint honored.
Minor: DecisionDetailsModal uses Tailwind `uppercase` class on small labels (vs avg / vs target / vs alt / Evidence / Uncertainty). Functionally fine; noted as it can confuse text-based assertions.
